run.service: Claude Code subagent (reads the bundle, writes the answer; no other tools)
run.settings: Trial run of the evaluation set. One new session per task, no follow-up messages. The answers are unedited. Manual scores are not filled in yet.

10.notes: All seven bugs fixed, but bug 4 keeps the timer on inst._timer (an own property on the instance) and only fixes the typo.

01.notes: Works in every engine; style.css uses raw colors (#ccc, #888, #0a7) instead of tokens.

02.notes: Adds nothing: inst.setState(function (s) { … }) is ignored, because setState takes an object (vf.store's set takes a function). The engine gives no warning.

05.notes: All checks pass. The Retry button sits inside the status element, which the task allows (the check was relaxed after this run to read the status text without the button).

06.notes: Locale files use flat dotted keys ("nav.home"); vf.t reads "nav.home" as nested objects, so every text shows its key and the console warns about missing messages.

07.notes: The search input re-renders on every key but has no id, data-ref or name, so the focus is not restored and typing stops after the first character. The report flagged focus restoration as not verified.

08.notes: The chart component is vf.attach('#sales', …); destroy() removes #sales itself, so showing the chart again finds no target.

09.notes: Design applied correctly in light, OS dark and data-theme="dark"; two padding values stay in px in app.css.
